notes: Next.js 16 app router (next 16.2.8) with no public/ folder yet. The mark today is app/icon.svg, a file-based metadata icon that Next links itself. serve keeps that convention: the kit's favicon.svg would replace app/icon.svg under that name, and the other kit files go to public/, which Next serves at the site root. The other path, favicon.svg in public/ with metadata.icons, is equally open until the kit lands.

Head tags are written by app/layout.tsx (metadata, viewport.themeColor #0b0d12, no colorScheme, no openGraph), which site.layout names. A head-tag test (artcraft-brand wiring.md §6) would hold each page's openGraph; the repository has no test runner yet.

check.mjs is not wired yet: the repository has no test script and no CI workflow. Proposed: `"test:brand": "node brand/check.mjs"` in package.json; running it in `prebuild` as well would make every Vercel deploy run it, which is a new blocking guard and the owner's call.
Today /favicon.ico answers 404 and there are no og tags (review 2026-11-02 §3.1); the footer links a Codeberg organisation recorded as empty (same review).
